gunsmod.ad.kind_gun: Anti-aircraft gun: bursts of explosive shells
gunsmod.ad.vhf: VHF: sees stealth aircraft about 3x better

gunsmod.desc.ad.radar_96l6: All-round search on a tall mast, the longest range
gunsmod.desc.ad.radar_giraffe: Mast lifts the antenna over trees, medium range
gunsmod.desc.ad.radar_mpq65: Phased array over a 110 degree sector, long range
gunsmod.desc.ad.radar_p18: Old but its long waves see stealth aircraft much better
gunsmod.desc.ad.sam_s400: 4 missiles cold-launched upright, the longest range
gunsmod.desc.ad.sam_tamir: 20 small missiles, quick to fire, short range
gunsmod.desc.arena_tool: Builds a 50x50 battlefield with a command console
gunsmod.desc.bipod: Lie down (Z) or crouch behind a block: the gun rests on it, barely any recoil or sway
gunsmod.desc.flashlight: Weapon light: a real beam that lights up the dark
gunsmod.desc.green_soldier: Friendly soldier. Fights the red team
gunsmod.desc.heli: Attack helicopter with rockets and a chin gun
gunsmod.desc.jeep: Military jeep with a turret, 40 km/h
gunsmod.desc.laser_sight: Much better hip fire, visible beam
gunsmod.desc.missile_3: Fuel-air blast: giant fireball and a pressure wave that flattens 28 blocks
gunsmod.desc.missile_4: Drills 15 blocks into the ground, then erupts
gunsmod.desc.missile_5: Strategic warhead: mushroom cloud, firestorm, 64 block shockwave
gunsmod.desc.nv_scope: 3.5x night vision: the dark turns into a bright green and white picture
gunsmod.desc.orchard_tool: Builds a 300 x 500 orchard battlefield with two bases, vehicles and a runway each
gunsmod.desc.red_soldier: Enemy soldier. Attacks green soldiers and survival players
gunsmod.desc.smoke_grenade: Smoke screen that blocks soldiers' vision
gunsmod.desc.suppressor: Silent shots, no muzzle flash, soldiers don't hear you
gunsmod.desc.tank: Main battle tank for one: drive, aim the turret with your view, fire
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.a10: Close air support: slow, armoured, shrugs off guns; the GAU-8 30 mm tears up armour, Mavericks, AIM-9 for defence
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.apache: 30 mm chain gun, lock-on Hellfire missiles, Hydra rockets
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.b2: Stealth bomber you can fly (or a soldier flies it): six huge bombs that rise into a mushroom cloud, no damage to blocks
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.btr82: 8x8 armoured carrier: 30 mm cannon, machine gun, carries 3 on top, swims
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.challenger: Heaviest armour, slowest, HESH shells with a big blast
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.cram: Air defence gun: shoots down rockets, shells, missiles and aircraft by itself
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.f16: Fighter jet, 180 km/h: needs a run to take off, Mavericks against vehicles, Sidewinders against aircraft, 20 mm cannon, flares
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.f22: Stealth air superiority: the fastest jet, cruises without reheat, very hard to see on radar, AIM-120s and JDAMs carried inside, M61 cannon
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.f35: Stealth multirole: hard to see on radar, AIM-120 / AIM-9X and JDAMs, 25 mm cannon with explosive shells
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.grad: Rocket artillery: forty 122 mm rockets over a wide area
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.helicopter: Light and nimble: 20 mm chin gun, Hydra rockets
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.himars: Rocket artillery: six heavy guided rockets, up to 330 blocks
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.hind: Flying tank: 12.7 mm gatling, S-8 salvos, FAB-250 bombs, Shturm missiles, carries 4
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.ka52: Coaxial rotors, turns fastest: 30 mm cannon, laser-guided Vikhr missiles, S-8
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.leopard: Fastest tank, long 120 mm L55 gun: flattest shot, fastest reload
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.maus: Super-heavy: 188 tonnes, 128 mm gun, almost nothing gets through its armour; very slow
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.mig29: Agile dogfighter: R-73 shot off-boresight with the helmet sight, KAB guided bombs, 30 mm cannon
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.object279: Super-heavy on four tracks: saucer hull, 130 mm gun
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.pantsir: Air defence: radar, 12 guided missiles, twin 30 mm guns; only hits aircraft
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.pickup: Civilian double-cab pickup: soldiers ride it from place to place, they jump out when they meet the enemy
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.su35: Supermanoeuvrable fighter: turns tighter than anything, R-77 and R-73 missiles, Kh-29 against vehicles, 30 mm cannon
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.suv: Civilian SUV: four soldiers, quick on the road, they jump out when they meet the enemy
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.t90: 125 mm gun hits hardest, slow autoloader, low and agile
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.tank: Main battle tank: fast turbine, quick loader, balanced armour
gunsmod.desc.vehicle.tow_humvee: Humvee with a TOW anti-tank missile launcher: the missile flies where the gunner aims

gunsmod.tip.ad_use: Takes your side when placed and links to nearby radars / launchers | sneak + use: switch side
gunsmod.tip.adlink1: Use on a radar, then on a launcher or gun to link them (again to unlink)
gunsmod.tip.adlink2: Sneak + use on a launcher clears its links | up to 4 radars per launcher, 96 blocks apart at most
gunsmod.tip.arena_tool: Use on the ground twice to build
gunsmod.tip.attach_hint: Install it at a Gunsmith Table
gunsmod.tip.b21: W/S throttle, look to steer, takes off at about 60 km/h | [attack] drop a bomb where you look | radar and heat seekers can not see it
gunsmod.tip.b22: Only RPGs can hurt it: 1% chance for each rocket passing close, 5 hits bring it down; soldiers only bomb groups
gunsmod.tip.btr821: Commander drives and fires: attack 30 mm, use machine gun
gunsmod.tip.btr822: 3 passengers ride protected | swims | iron: repair
gunsmod.tip.controls: Hold attack: fire | Tap use: aim | R: reload
gunsmod.tip.convoy1: Use: plan the column (side, vehicles in order, helicopters)
gunsmod.tip.convoy2: Attack: the convoy rolls out where you look | route planner in the other hand: it follows the route
gunsmod.tip.cram1: Place it near your base: it guards the sky on its own
gunsmod.tip.cram2: Ride it to aim by hand | attack: fire
gunsmod.tip.fpv1: Use: launches at what's under the crosshair (220 m)
gunsmod.tip.fpv2: It loses the link if you die or go too far
gunsmod.tip.grad1: Ride it, look at the ground far away: the launcher lays itself
gunsmod.tip.grad2: Attack: ripple of 40 rockets | Use: one rocket
gunsmod.tip.gun.g36: Built-in optic in the carry handle
gunsmod.tip.gun.igla: Aim at an aircraft: the seeker growls, then locks (solid red box). The missile chases it; only aircraft are hurt
gunsmod.tip.gun.m200: Longest reach of any rifle: 300 m, very flat trajectory
gunsmod.tip.gun.m82: .50 BMG: goes through walls and hurts light vehicles
gunsmod.tip.gun.rpg7_tbg: Thermobaric round: a fireball and a pressure wave that fills rooms and trenches and sets everything near on fire
gunsmod.tip.gun.vss: Built-in suppressor: no flash, quiet shot, soldiers do not hear it
gunsmod.tip.heli1: W/S: nose down/up | A/D: turn | Jump: climb | Sneak: descend, get out once landed
gunsmod.tip.heli2: Attack: weapon | Use: gun | R: next weapon | X: flares | iron: repair
gunsmod.tip.himars1: Ride it, look at the ground far away: the launcher lays itself
gunsmod.tip.himars2: Attack: whole salvo | Use: one rocket | bots fire on enemies their team sees
gunsmod.tip.jeep1: Use: get in (driver first) | Sneak + use: gunner seat
gunsmod.tip.jeep2: V: change seat | H: horn | iron ingot: repair
gunsmod.tip.jet1: W/S throttle | look to steer | A/D rudder | at 70 km/h look up to take off, the gear folds by itself
gunsmod.tip.jet2: Attack: missile (lock first) | Use: cannon | R: Maverick/Sidewinder | X: flares
gunsmod.tip.missile_heavy: Heavy missile: load it into a Heavy Missile Launcher
gunsmod.tip.missile_hint: Load it into a Missile Launch Station
gunsmod.tip.orchard_tool: Use on the ground to see the outline, use again on the same spot to build (clears the area!)
gunsmod.tip.pantsir1: Radar finds helicopters: hold one in the sight until LOCKED, attack fires a missile
gunsmod.tip.pantsir2: Use: radar-directed 30 mm guns | never hits ground targets
gunsmod.tip.pickup1: WASD: drive | two in the cab, two in the bed
gunsmod.tip.pickup2: No weapons: soldiers get out to fight
gunsmod.tip.radio1: Use (or press U): the squad command board
gunsmod.tip.radio2: Follow me recruits the soldiers of your side around you
gunsmod.tip.remote1: Sneak + use: mark the block you look at as target
gunsmod.tip.remote2: Use: open the launch control panel
gunsmod.tip.remote3: Use on a station: link it (up to 100) | Sneak: unlink
gunsmod.tip.repair1: Use on a vehicle: mends the worst damaged part and the armour
gunsmod.tip.repair2: Sneak + use: damage report (engine, tracks, turret, gun, fuel)
gunsmod.tip.route1: Use on the ground: add a point | sneak-use by a point: branch from it (up to 3)
gunsmod.tip.route2: Hit a soldier, a vehicle or a vehicle garage: it follows the route
gunsmod.tip.route3: Sneak-use elsewhere: undo | sneak-use in the air: clear | soldiers keep it on their dog tag
gunsmod.tip.shahed1: Sneak + use: mark the block you look at as the target
gunsmod.tip.shahed2: Use: launch; it flies there by itself and dives in
gunsmod.tip.soldier_controls: Patrols and fights on its own | Give it a gun, remote or missiles by using them on it | Sneak + empty hand: gear
gunsmod.tip.spawner_hint: Use it on a Vehicle Spawner to keep one in service
gunsmod.tip.suv2: No weapons: soldiers get out to fight
gunsmod.tip.tag_empty: Use on a soldier to save his loadout
gunsmod.tip.tag_use: Put it in a Deployment Pad, or use on the ground
gunsmod.tip.tank1: Attack: 120 mm gun | Use: machine gun | WASD: drive
gunsmod.tip.tow_humvee1: Gunner: aim and attack to fire, then keep the sight on the target
gunsmod.tip.tow_humvee2: Driver and passengers are protected until it is destroyed
gunsmod.tip.unlinked: Not linked: use it on a launch station
gunsmod.ui.drag_hint: drag to rotate, scroll to zoom
gunsmod.ui.no_remote: No remote: give one for artillery
gunsmod.ui.place_gun: Put a gun in the slot below
